findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_order, get_order_status, reschedule_session, reschedule_booking · Public sink: create_order, get_order_status, cancel_order, cancel_booking, renounce_certificate, reschedule_session, reschedule_booking · Destructive: renounce_certificate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_order, get_order_status, reschedule_session, reschedule_booking · Public sink: create_order, get_order_status, cancel_order, cancel_booking, renounce_certificate, reschedule_session, reschedule_booking · Destructive: renounce_certificate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
